stories.title: Mold football club launches new girls’ team as sponsorship deal enters second season
stories.summary: Mold Alexandra FC has launched a new under-9s girls’ football team, for children in school years 3 and 4, funded by a second season of sponsorship from PR agency Outwrite. stories.title: GP referrals to Glan Clwyd A&E sent to email address nobody was monitoring, inspectors told
stories.summary: GPs were sending patient referrals to Ysbyty Glan Clwyd’s emergency department using an email address that was not being monitored, inspectors were told, meaning some patients arrived without the department knowing they had been referred. stories.title: Flintshire Catholic super-school consultation rejected by 96% for second time
stories.summary: A second statutory consultation on plans to close and merge four Catholic schools in Flintshire has drawn 2,813 responses, with around 96 per cent opposed to every element of the proposal. stories.title: Plaid Cymru, SNP and Sinn Fein sign memorandum on independence and closer EU ties
stories.summary: Plaid Cymru has signed a new agreement with the SNP and Sinn Féin pledging closer cooperation on areas of shared interest, including renewable energy, the economy and strengthened relations with Europe. stories.title: Roadworks: what’s happening on Flintshire’s roads this week
stories.summary: Drivers across Flintshire and Deeside face a number of road closures and temporary traffic lights this week, with several new schemes starting. New closures this week Stag Lane in Ewloe Shotton is closed from 14 to 18 September for United Utilities water works. Golftyn Lane in Connah’s Quay is closed from 14 to 25 September
